_note: Input images for TRELLIS. These are NOT textures - they are reference photos that get turned into 3D meshes, so the rules are different again.
_rules: TRELLIS segments the subject with rembg before reconstructing, so it needs ONE object, fully in frame, on a plain background, with no cropping and no scene. A three-quarter view gives it two visible sides to reason about; a flat side-on view leaves the front and back to guesswork. Neutral studio light, because any baked shadow becomes geometry.
